result:
My verdict on DG1 round 14 is **PASS**: F-DG1-135 is fixed, and I found nothing High, Critical or mandatory. Two checks in my record are not PASS (one FAIL, one BLOCKED). The gate validator counts each of them as an error, so the gate needs your decision on them (see "Needs your decision").

I worked on candidate `sha256:dd747fe1…c8559` at freeze commit `985d0fa`, and the candidate ID recomputed the same before and after all runs. HEAD moved once during my run when the runner auto-committed the domain reviewer's round-14 files. The candidate ID didn't change, and I didn't read those files.

**F-DG1-135 (Low): CLOSED_VERIFIED**
- The fix is test-only. The code change is one line in `architecture.testkit.ts`: files count as tests only if they are named `*.test.ts` or `*.test.tsx`.
- I wrote my own probe, which drops files into the real module folder and runs the real check. It passes 22/22 on Node 22 and Node 24:
  - `*.test.mts` and the other non-TS test names now get the full module rules.
  - Real `*.test.ts` and `*.test.tsx` files keep their test exemption.
  - Look-alike names such as `.TEST.ts` or `.tests.ts` are not treated as tests.
- I also checked what the build and vitest actually do. A `*.test.mts` file ends up in `dist` and vitest never runs it, so treating it as a non-test is correct. A `*.test.tsx` is neither built nor run, so its exemption does no harm.
- The project's own `architecture.test.ts` passes 128/128 on both runtimes.

**No regression (Node 22 and Node 24)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build and static checks | All exit 0; OpenAPI lint reports 33 operations |
| Unit tests | 321/321 on both; web tests 110/110 (F-DG1-214 still fixed) |
| Integration | 200/200 in three runs (two on Node 22, one on Node 24); no 57P01 in the database logs (F-DG1-009 still fixed) |
| Migrations, audit table, contract | Migrations 0001–0008 apply; the audit table refuses UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE; every operation is covered, including getBrandingTokens |
| Browser tests | 22/22 in English and Arabic, including the BU-Lead create → Edit/Archive journey without reload (F-DG1-210 still fixed) |
| Accessibility | 0 axe violations on 15 screens per language |
| Acceptance A12/A13/A14/A18/A20 | All pass |
| Register, pipeline and reconcile validators | All pass |
| 12 DG1-final requirements | All IMPLEMENTED, no missing evidence |

**Findings**
- **Proposed F-DG1-217 (Low, not mandatory, REQ-S16-003).** The module lint crashes with an unhelpful TypeScript error ("Debug Failure. Output generation failed") on any `*.d.ts`, `*.d.mts` or `*.d.cts` file instead of reporting a problem. It fails closed: the check goes red and nothing slips through. It has existed since round 5, is unrelated to the F-DG1-135 change, and the real code has no such file today. My record logs it as check QA14-09 with result FAIL.
- **Blocked:** one installer sub-check, AC-1 (effect), could not run because my sandbox has no registry network. REQ-DLV-042 rests on the orchestrator's installer log, which shows 14/14 and hasn't changed since round 13. Rounds 12 and 13 recorded this the same way.

**Needs your decision**
- The validator reports QA14-09 (FAIL) and QA14-17b (BLOCKED) as errors. I left both as they are rather than mark them PASS.
- F-DG1-217 has to be either sent for repair or accepted as an observation. Accepting it needs a specialist and the release-auditor each to add a verification entry with status ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION.

Two notes on the evidence:
- On Node 24, Playwright prints wrong line numbers for the browser tests (past the end of the file). Round 13 shows the same; it comes from the tool, not the product.
- My first probe run collided with the real-tree check because I ran them in parallel. That was my mistake, so I re-ran them separately.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG1/round-14/`:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.verifications.json
- qa-verifier.findings.json
- qa-verifier.md

Logs and screenshots are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/round-14/`. The probe is `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/dg1-r14-test-classification-probe.test.ts`. I removed all temporary clones afterwards.
